title: hamnir config
description: Configuration for hamnir, a persona-first OIDC dev provider. Note: cross-referential rules (persona.group must match a groups[].id, sub unique across personas, client ids unique, static mount keys not colliding after leading-slash normalisation) are enforced by hamnir at load time, not by this schema.

issuer.description: OIDC issuer URL. Omit to derive the issuer per-request from the request host — handy when every caller reaches hamnir at one address (plain localhost, a port-forward). Do NOT rely on it for split setups where a browser and a backend use different hosts: discovery advertises endpoints at whichever host performed discovery, so mixed flows break. For split front/back-channel setups set issuer plus browser_url instead.

browser_url.description: Browser-facing base URL, for split front/back-channel setups where the browser reaches hamnir at a different address than backend callers (e.g. http://localhost:5556 vs http://hamnir:5556 in docker-compose). Browser-facing endpoints (authorize, end_session) and static asset URLs are advertised at this base; token, userinfo and jwks stay on the issuer. Requires a static issuer.

clients.description: Registered OAuth clients. Providing any client puts hamnir in strict mode: only these client_ids and their exact redirect URIs are accepted. Omit the whole block for permissive dev mode (any client_id and redirect_uri).

groups.description: Persona groups, used to organise and colour-code the persona picker.

scopes.description: Custom scope definitions mapping a scope name to the list of claim names it releases.

audiences.description: Values for the aud claim of minted access tokens (API identifiers, URLs or URNs). Replaces the default [client_id]; list the client id explicitly if you want both. A client may override this with its own audiences list. Note: the ID token also receives these audiences, with the client_id always appended — spec-legal, but broader than Auth0/Azure ID tokens. Omit for the default aud of [client_id].

personas.description: The selectable identities shown in the persona picker.

static.description: Serve local directories of static files (e.g. profile images) under the reserved /.static/ URL root, and reference them from claims via the prefix marker.

prefix.description: Claim-value marker that opts a value into static-URL substitution. Defaults to "hamnir://". Override if you need that literal string elsewhere.

paths.description: Map of mount name to local directory. Each is served under /.static/<mount>/. Reference a file as <prefix><mount>/<file>. Mount names must be non-empty and must not contain "/" or ".." (a single leading "/" is tolerated and stripped).

lifetimes.description: Lifetimes of issued tokens, as Go duration strings (e.g. "90s", "5m", "24h"). Tune these to mirror the IdP your app meets in production. Omit a field to use its default.

refresh_token.description: Refresh token lifetime. Each rotation issues a fresh token with this full lifetime, so an actively-refreshing session slides forward; it also bounds how long an idle session survives. Defaults to 24h.

signing_key.description: The provider's RSA-2048 token signing key: standard base64 of the PKCS#8 DER, one line, no PEM armor. hamnir is a development-only provider — this key protects nothing real and is intended to be committed with the rest of the config so every developer and replica runs a byte-identical IdP. Generate with "hamnir init".

redirect_uris.description: Exact redirect URIs permitted for this client. Omit for a back-channel-only client (introspection/revocation) that never performs a redirect flow.

post_logout_redirect_uris.description: Exact post-logout redirect URIs permitted for this client.

secret.description: Client secret. Omit for a public client that authenticates with PKCE.

audiences.description: Per-client override of the top-level audiences list for this client's tokens. An explicit empty list opts this client out of the global audiences, back to the default aud of [client_id]. Omit to inherit the global list.

id.description: Unique group identifier, referenced by persona.group.

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the persona picker.

colour.description: Accent colour as a 3- or 6-digit hex code, e.g. "#8b5cf6".

name.description: Display name shown in the persona picker.

description.description: Optional secondary text shown under the name in the picker.

group.description: Group id this persona belongs to. Must match a groups[].id (enforced by hamnir at load time).

claims.description: Claims released for this persona. Arbitrary claim keys are allowed; sub is required and must be unique across personas.

sub.description: Stable subject identifier. Required, and unique across personas.

tokens.description: Optional static secrets for programmatic login: each can be exchanged for real tokens via the OAuth 2.0 token exchange grant (RFC 8693) — POST the string as subject_token with subject_token_type https://hamnir.dev/token-type/persona to the token endpoint. Any non-empty string works; must be unique across all personas (enforced by hamnir at load time).
